_note: Dream Theater management (module Base\DreamTheater). Not read by the festival loader. Sources: client luaui dlgwhiteday (tAddSy), dlgmidautumninfo MidAutumn_Config[10369] (milestones, wish preview, rank tables), Server_Key tWhiteDay2024NPC / tWhiteDayLua, videos UQaPhJISUQ0 / qiOKUEANFQw / 9ZTyLoh6Pmk / tTO1t9_Tzts (tools\ProtoStudio\out\dreamtheater_video_diff.md). Every value marked DERIVED is not in any official source and can be changed here.
_recruit_note: Official window: Agnes offers ONE contract a day (luaui dlgwhitedaymain tNpcShowTaskInfo: TaskIndex 1-7 = the 7 recruitments in this order, 8 = cleaning, 9 = troupe troubles). Finishing that contract makes the performance ready (videos qiOKUEANFQw 2:48-3:02 and 9ZTyLoh6Pmk 7:28-7:32: recruitment done -> performance at once).
_daily_note: DERIVED: after the 7 recruitments the daily contract alternates cleaning (8, even day number) / troupe troubles (9, odd). The official choice rule is not in the client.
_levels_note: points/silver/upgradeFunds = official client tAddSy. funds per performance: Lv1 100000 (video qiOK 3:14), Lv3 200000 (video 9ZTy 7:50 / 8:56); Lv2/4/5 DERIVED (+50000 per level).
_points_note: Theater Points = level points + 30 per recruited member: Lv1 1 member 330 (qiOK 3:14), Lv3 4 members 520, Lv3 5 members 550 (9ZTy 7:50 / 8:56). Split 50% / 30% / 20% (Audience / Reputation / Growth, all videos).
_silver_note: Settlement 2 (DlgWhiteDayActFinishTwo, qiOK 3:54): Income from Number of Performers 1 (Irwin) + Income from Theater Level 8 = 9 Wish Silver Coins.
_wish_note: Items = official reward preview MidAutumn_Config[10369].PreviewReward[1] (14 rows; the ',1' highlight = Love Velvet x3); all of them also appear in the videos. Weights DERIVED.
_milestones_note: Official: client MidAutumn_Config[10369].Rank.Total[1..9] + texts luaUiRes[1273][10369].Total (video qiOK 5:30 / tTO1 3:14).
_rank_note: Official (tWhiteDayLua Email): the local ranking (>= 30000 Theater Points) settles 8:00 (US) Mar 25 and MAILS 1 Dream Splendid/Starry/Glowy/Lucky Box (sender Agnes, title Dream Ranking, Content[1..10]). The boxes open to their official item texts (DreamTheaterItems).
_boxes_note: Official item texts 3347479-3347482 (+ MidAutumn_Config[10369].Rank[1] '3322813 0 n 3 10080' = 7-day medals).
